topicDecision.angle: Decide whether the newly completed 20-hectare Rainforest Wild Adventure is worth a full weekday, using the current ticket inclusion, activity eligibility, heat and two-zone transfer.
topicDecision.reason: Selected on 25 August 2026 because the East expansion completed the full park on 29 May, the official ticket page still advertises a limited opening offer of up to nine included Adventure+ activities on weekdays, and an independent June field guide documents the new East experience. The angle has no destination or wildlife-park overlap in current inventory. It describes a new-access and current-value signal, not proof of popularity or rising demand.

claims.text: Rainforest Wild Adventure completed its second zone and Mandai grand opening on 29 May 2026; West first opened 12 March 2025.
The two zones cover 20 hectares and currently house 58 species.
Daily hours are 09:00–18:00 with last entry at 17:00.
Current non-resident admission is S$55 adult and S$39 child aged 3–12; under-threes enter free with an eligible ticketed adult.
Current resident admission is S$50 adult, S$35 child/local student and S$25 senior.

The current opening offer includes up to nine Adventure+ activities on regular weekdays and up to five on weekends/public holidays; completion is not guaranteed and closures do not trigger refunds or extensions.
East and West are linked by internal transport or an 800m walk of about 20 minutes.
M2 from Khatib costs S$2.50 each way for ages seven and above, takes about 20 minutes, and uses contactless payment.
The current adult MRT fare table caps normal card fares at S$2.57.
For 17–31 August 2026, most daily highs are forecast at 33–34°C, a few at 35°C, with some short late-morning/afternoon thunderstorms and below-average rainfall.
Canopy Jump uses 13m or 20m platforms and requires height 1.35–2.1m, weight 20–120kg, sports attire and unassisted stair use.
Cavern Restaurant opens 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–21:00, with weekday two-course lunch from S$28++.
Mandai Boardwalk is free, 3.3km, opens 07:00–19:00 with last entry 18:00, and takes roughly 70–85 minutes.
Animals may move out of view and encounters are not guaranteed.
Changi MRT reaches the network via Tanah Merah; foreign contactless cards may attract an administration fee.

conflicts.issue: Some older pages and maps use Rainforest Wild ASIA or Rainforest Wild and cover only the former West phase.
conflicts.resolution: The article uses the current Rainforest Wild Adventure name and 20-hectare/two-zone facts from 29 May 2026 pages; older materials are used only where explicitly still current.

conflicts.issue: The official opening offer says “up to” nine activities on weekdays/five on peak days and has no public end date.
conflicts.resolution: The article labels the inclusion as current on 25 August 2026, never promises completion, and tells readers to check the dated ticket before payment.

editorNotes: Candidate ranking on 25 August 2026: (1) Rainforest Wild Adventure, score 94/100, selected for its May 2026 full opening, current limited-value inclusion, complete official operational evidence and no inventory overlap; (2) Singapore Oceanarium, 86/100, timely but the CRYBABY activation ends 30 August and a viewing panel is temporarily closed; (3) teamLab Biovortex Kyoto, 84/100, strong July million-visitor signal but variable pricing and Japan logistics make the attraction decision more volatile. No candidate is called trending or popular. Article assumptions: Changi arrival, independent traveler, full weekday, SGD budget.
